681	    """Whether a new cause -> effect edge would close a directed cycle.

702	            if nxt not in visited:
703	                visited.add(nxt)
704	                stack.append(nxt)
705	    return False

1347	                AuthorizationDecisionEvent.machine_id == machine_id

1349	        ).all()
1350	    )

1720	    cause -> effect edge would close a directed cycle among the edges scanned
1721	    so far is reported as broken. Read-only: issues no writes.
1722	    """

1726	        .order_by(

1735	                AuthorizationDecisionEvent.machine_id == machine_id
1736	            )
1737	        ).all()
1738	    )
